projects.name: ORBIT
projects.desc: An autonomous AI agent that runs on voice — no wake word; it understands, does the work, talks on phone calls, and learns new skills from its own work.
projects.long: ORBIT is a self-built autonomous AI agent with 110+ tools. You speak, it understands the intent — no wake word, no menus — and gets the work done across the desktop, the web, and even live phone calls. After multi-step work it saves what it learned as a reusable skill, so the same task runs faster next time.

projects.name: StayUp
projects.desc: A hostel attendance app with a live build and a Supabase backend.
projects.long: StayUp makes hostel attendance painless: mark and track attendance from the phone, backed by Supabase, shipped as a working app with a live web build.

projects.name: Karcha Tracker
projects.desc: A personal expense tracker with clear monthly views of where the money goes.
projects.long: Karcha Tracker records everyday spending and rolls it up into monthly views, so the leaks in a budget are visible at a glance.

projects.name: Think & Control
projects.desc: Hands-free computer control through a plain webcam — move your head to move the focus, blink to select.
projects.long: Think & Control turns a normal webcam into a hands-free controller: head direction steps the focus across the screen like a D-pad, and a long blink selects — no special hardware, no wearables.
